verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs say its Loop agent can build dashboards, and the product tracks latency, cost, and quality in real time from traces that capture latency and token usage. Beyond that, the custom-dashboard capability is thinly documented. Missing for 10: first-party docs on a custom dashboard/chart builder, explicit error-rate metrics, documented dashboard configuration beyond the Loop agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics

citations.quote: Ask Braintrust's AI agent to investigate your data and build scorers, datasets, and dashboards
